input.text: Cinematic, fluid and natural, locked camera with a very slight push-in. The first image is the starting frame and the second image is the final frame. A young barista in a green apron, seen from behind-left, holds his phone toward a cardboard box of fresh croissants on a marble counter in a warm cafe. The phone screen shows the camera detecting croissants with small green labels, then the screen smoothly changes to a proposal screen with two surprise packs and a black Publish button, and his finger taps the screen. Keep the faces, the cafe, the lighting and the box identical in both frames. No new text, no logos, no subtitles, no music, no speech.
